item.title: Bentonville Daily — August 9, 2026
item.description:
A Heat Advisory is in effect for Benton County with heat index values up to 108 expected Sunday, alongside city meetings on finance and a one-cent sales tax proposal.
Heat Advisory in effect through Sunday evening. The National Weather Service has issued a Heat Advisory for Benton County with heat index values up to 108 from noon to 8 PM CDT Sunday.
Combined Committee of the Whole and city council meets August 11. The council is asked to approve several zoning changes, a vacation of a right of way, and two grants for parks and traffic technology. Agendas for 1 other meeting this period are also published.
Taziki’s Mediterranean Café opens in Rogers. Taziki’s Mediterranean Café opened at 1771 W. Pleasant Grove Road, Suite 104 in Rogers. The approximately 2,900-square-foot restaurant includes seating for 85 guests and involved about $950,000 investment.
Benton County holds meeting on One-Cent sales tax. Benton County’s Council meeting addressed the one-cent sales tax proposal.
Fayetteville confirms cooling center locations through August 16. The City of Fayetteville has confirmed cooling shelters for the week of August 8 through 16 amid high temperatures.
